_comment: Intentional stub-vs-real-Maya divergences (D-049b). Entries carry verdict + ref: ref anchors into the evidence layer (docs/visual-callform-matrix.md — the single source of truth, D-056③); verdict is the conclusion. Prefer fixing the divergence over allowing it. Class-level entries exempt their methods too. Baseline: presence-baseline.json, collected on Maya 2024.

omui.MImage.verdict: stub-only dual-location — real MImage lives in maya.api.OpenMaya on <=2024 and moves to OpenMayaUI in 2025+; the stub models both so _MImage dual-resolution is exercised against either layout

cmds.listAttr.verdict: present in real Maya 2024 - absent from baseline because the baseline collector only probed the then-current stub surface; call form verified verbatim against the official CommandsPython page

cmds.attributeQuery.verdict: present in real Maya 2024 - absent from baseline for the same coverage reason as cmds.listAttr; call form verified verbatim against the official CommandsPython page
